item.title: NY Prisons, Winter Olympics & More: Extended Interview with Assemblyman Matt Simpson
item.description: Assemblyman Simpson discusses Governor Hochul’s backing of an amendment that would authorize a land swap that would allow for the sale of 3 closed state prisons that sit on or near State Forest Preserve land. Assemblyman Simpson also weighs in on efforts to move ahead with a joint New York City/Lake Placid bid to host another Winter Olympics in New York State.

item.title: NY Assemblyman Simpson on Skyrocketing Utility Bills & Climate Law Repeal
item.description: The North Country’s delegation in the New York State Legislature recently gave community leaders an overview of the legislative session in Albany and the “affordability crisis” happening across New York this winter at the yearly Legislative Breakfast Forum hosted by the North Country Chamber of Commerce. Much of the discussion was about the high utility costs many customers have been experiencing this winter.
